tasks.title: Bootstrap multi-agent coordination protocol
acceptance: handoff.md exposes canonical coordination issue numbers at the top
docs/manger.log records role, assignment, acceptance criteria and route decisions
this JSON registry is machine-readable and keeps at least two unfinished tasks while one worker is active
worker log and architecture/plan documents exist
changes are split across multiple commits and independently audited before merge

tasks.title: Independently audit PR #38 release security gate integration
acceptance: diff is compared against the stated four-workflow release contract
exact-SHA and GITHUB_SHA binding are verified from source rather than PR description
workflow run conclusions for the PR head are checked
review records PASS or actionable rejection evidence
merge occurs only if the audit passes and required checks are successful

tasks.title: Triage formal v7 release readiness and external runner blockers
acceptance: current formal release workflow prerequisites are enumerated from repository source
external-only blockers such as trusted signing runner requirements are separated from code defects
no release_ready=true or formal publish action is performed without satisfied gates
route recommendation is written to the manager log and project plan

tasks.title: Prioritize open Dependabot major-version updates
acceptance: open dependency PRs are grouped by runtime/build/security risk
security-relevant updates are distinguished from optional major churn
each recommended merge or defer decision cites compatibility evidence
no broad dependency batch is merged without project-specific validation

tasks.title: Repository-wide bug and contract audit after v7.0.2 changes
acceptance: audit focuses on release/update trust, IPC boundaries, persistence, and extension handoff contracts
findings are reproducible from source or CI evidence
confirmed defects become separate prioritized tasks with narrow acceptance criteria
speculative findings are not merged as fixes

tasks.title: Refine README from independently verified project state
acceptance: README describes architecture, build/release boundaries and current readiness accurately
claims are verified against source and CI rather than copied from stale planning docs
quick-start material remains concise and learnable
release readiness wording does not imply an unsigned or ungated formal release
